item.title: Java Class Loading
item.description:
Class loading converts a binary representation into a Class object. Linking and initialization are separate steps, thus loading a type does not imply that its static initializer has run.

Loaders and Type Identity #

The JDK supplies bootstrap, platform, and application loaders. The bootstrap loader defines core platform classes and is represented by null in selected APIs; the platform loader defines platform modules; the application loader loads application classes from the class path or module path.
